```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(curatedMetagenomicData)
library(ExperimentHub)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ExperimentHub))
myquery = query(ExperimentHub(), "curatedMetagenomicData")
```

identify studies with stool samples processed via metaphlan
```{r}
studies <- as.data.frame(grep("(?=.*stool)(?=.*metaphlan)", myquery$title, perl=TRUE, val=TRUE))
```

Try to get relative abundance data from one study 
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(curatedMetagenomicData))
matson = MatsonV_2018.metaphlan_bugs_list.stool()
experimentData(matson)
taxa <- exprs(matson)

write.csv(taxa, "/Users/wheeler.1017/Desktop/meta_analysis/matson2018_ra.csv")
```

get combined meta data
```{r}
meta <- curatedMetagenomicData::combined_metadata
write.csv(meta, "../data/meta_anlysis_meta_data.csv")
```
